defs.def: to give sb money for work, goods, services, etc. 付费；付酬

ex.s: Slowly but surely, my efforts to adjust to the new routine paid off.
ex.t: 我努力适应新作息，缓慢但稳步地见到了成效。

ex.s: I pays to put theory into practice.
ex.t: I 把理论付诸实践会有回报。

ex.s: Which provides eight weeks of paid employment along with training.
ex.t: 该项目提供八周的带薪就业和培训。

ex.s: She paid no attention.
ex.t: 她没有注意。

ex.s: Far from charging consumers high prices, many of these services are free (users pay, in effect, by handing over yet more data).
ex.t: 远非向消费者收取高价，许多这类服务都是免费的（用户实际上是通过交出更多数据来付费的）。

ex.s: At first, I only regarded it as a hobby, but companies started paying me to take photos and publish them.
ex.t: 起初，我只把它看作是一种爱好，但公司开始付钱给我拍照和发布它们。

ex.s: In which case does a student have to pay for the replacement of the student ID card?
ex.t: 在什么情况下学生必须为补学生证付费？

ex.s: How much will the man pay?
ex.t: 那位男士要付多少钱？

ex.s: Pay for others’ help                D.
ex.t: 为别人的帮助付费 D.

ex.s: It's not just corporate jobs, or even paid work that can help keep your brain fit, Then points out.
ex.t: 不只是公司工作，甚至付费工作才能帮助你保持大脑健康，滕指出。

ex.s: But I imagine that, while money is indeed wonderful and necessary, rereading an author’s work is the highest currency a reader can pay them.
ex.t: 但我想，虽然金钱确实美好且必不可少，但重读一位作者的作品，是读者能给予他们的最高回报。

defs.def: to give sb money that you owe them 交纳；偿还

ex.s: I missed that paragraph because I was thinking of something else, but I’m going to keep on going and start paying close attention.”
ex.t: 我漏看了那一段，因为我在想别的事情，但我会继续读下去，并开始集中注意力。"

ex.s: So it pays to be sure, because you want to get it right the first time
ex.t: 因此，确定是值得的，因为您希望第一次就做对

ex.s: He used donated funds and his own money to pay the 50 pounds per child that the British government required.
ex.t: 他用捐赠的资金和自己的钱来支付英国政府要求的每个孩子50英镑的费用。

ex.s: How much do you pay for two articles obtained from an international library?
ex.t: 从国际图书馆获取两篇文章你要付多少钱？

ex.s: How much do you pay for renting a bike with hand brake and three gears for two days?
ex.t: 租一辆带手刹和三挡的自行车两天要付多少钱？

ex.s: However, you need to pay 2 euros a day for Wi-Fi.
ex.t: 不过，你需要每天支付2欧元用于Wi-Fi。

ex.s: How much should you pay if you make a 12-mouth subscription to TOKNOW with gift pack from China?
ex.t: 如果你从中国订阅带礼品包的TOKNOW 12个月，应该付多少钱？

ex.s: But   53    all this, Hannah still has the   54    life of a Winnipeg schoolgirl, except that she pays regular visits to homeless people.
ex.t: 但尽管如此，汉娜依然过着温尼伯女学生____54____的生活，只是她会定期去看望无家可归的人。

defs.def: to produce a profit 企业等
to result in some advantage or profit for sb 受益；划算
to suffer or be punished for your beliefs or actions 付代价；遭受惩罚

ex.s: Now I was paying the price — to write a five-page essay on “Why I Should Not Talk in Class”.
ex.t: 现在我付出了代价——要写一篇五页的文章，题目是"我为什么不该在课堂上讲话"。

ex.s: Be sure to pay a visit as part of your stay in the city.
ex.t: 在你逗留这座城市期间，一定要去参观。

ex.s: “Sleep is the price we pay for learning,” says Giulio Tononi, who developed the idea.
ex.t: "睡眠是我们为学习付出的代价，"提出这一理念的朱利奥·托诺尼说。

ex.s: High conscientiousness is related to lower job performance, especially in simple jobs where it doesn’t pay to be a perfectionist.
ex.t: 高度的责任心与较低的工作绩效有关，特别是在简单的工作中，作为一个完美主义者是不需要付出代价的。

defs.def: （与某些名词结合使用，表示做某事或付出某事物）

ex.s: Paying extra attention.
ex.t: 给予额外的关注。

ex.s: What should you pay most attention to when taking notes?

ex.t: 他们开自动驾驶汽车赴约，让空车绕楼转圈以逃避停车费。

ex.s: You find it whenever people ask how you’re doing because they care, and not because they’re getting paid to do so.
ex.t: 当你发现人们问你“最近好吗”是因为他们在乎，而不是因为他们拿工资这么做时，你就能感受到它。

ex.s: I had been too nervous to pay attention when he introduced himself!
ex.t: 他们同意立即采取行动。

ex.s: Learning to learn When you are extending or accepting an invitation, pay special attention to the following information:the date and time, what to bring, where to meet, etc.
ex.t: 学会学习：当你发出或接受邀请时，要特别注意以下信息：日期和时间、带什么、在哪里碰面等。

ex.s: Or was it simply cheaper to paint himself than to pay for a model?
ex.t: 还是油漆自己比花钱买模特更便宜？

ex.s: Pay an extra fee for delivery.
ex.t: 为配送支付额外费用。

ex.s: They pay all her expenses.
ex.t: 他们支付她所有的开销。

ex.s: How much would a couple with two children under 12 pay for admission?

ex.s: Hunters willingly pay the stamp price to ensure the survival of our natural resources.
ex.t: 猎人乐意支付鸭票的价格，以确保我们的自然资源得以存续。

ex.s: How much did Gomez pay for the football game last time?

ex.t: 而他的爸爸，阿尔伯特，拿走了我爸挣来的钱，用它来支付家庭开支。

ex.t: 毕业后她工作帮助兄弟姐妹们支付学费。

ex.s: Scientists in Louisiana were so concerned that they decided to pay hunters $5 a tail.

ex.t: 16．（30分）一天晚上我准备在杂货店付香蕉的钱时，恐惧突然袭来。我的钱包不见了。我只能把它落在了G9公交车上，而那辆车此刻正飞驰在黑暗中驶向某个（1）     站。

ex.s: Since April drinks companies have been forced to pay between 18p and 24p for every litre of sugary drink they produce or import, depending on the sugar content.
ex.t: 自4月份以来，饮料公司被迫为其生产或进口的每升含糖饮料支付18便士至24便士不等的费用，具体取决于含糖量。

ex.s: Skilled at putting up shelves and piecing together furniture, she never pays someone else to do a job she can do herself.
ex.t: 她擅长安装架子和拼装家具，从不花钱请别人做自己能做的事。

ex.s: So, we pay more attention to them.
